newsitem.title: CHINA: Weak China state cos seek finance abroad - official.
newsitem.headline: Weak China state cos seek finance abroad - official.

text.p: China's debt-laden state-owned enterprises are looking overseas to raise financing, but are still hindered by regulations, a senior official said on Sunday.

"It is predicted we neeed to pour in 2,000 billion yuan to help state-owned enterprises get out of their heavy debts and their losses in assets -- where does all this money come from?" Dong Fureng, a member of the Standing Committee of China's National People's Congress said on Sunday. He noted that the Chinese government and banking sector have run out of money to prop up the companies.

Developing commodity and trade finance could help ease the crunch and raise capital for enterprises to revamp their technology, boost trade and adjust product structure, Dong said in a speech. Dong is also vice chairman of the Financial and Economic Committee of the NPC.
He was addressing delegates at an international conference on commodity trade and financing held by Shangxiang Minmetals Holding Limited, and held in the south China city of Shenzhen.

"But China's commodity and trade finance has not yet fully developed and it hasn't done enough to exploit international commodity and trade finance..We don't have the corresponding regulations and laws," Dong said.
